create_cait_model: create a CaiT (Class-Attention in Image Transformer) model for image classification with configurable patch size, depth, and heads
build_transformer_layers: build a Transformer module with layer dropout that stacks attention and feed-forward layers with layer scaling
create_attention_talking_heads: create an Attention module with talking heads mechanism using pre- and post-softmax head mixing parameters
test_layer_scale: test a LayerScale wrapper that scales a function's output by a learnable parameter initialized based on network depth
build_feedforward: build a FeedForward module with layer normalization, GELU activation, and dropout for transformer blocks
